header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: to grant you good health” — if he recites this Du'a seven times, he will certainly be cured.” Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) has narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ شَهِدَ الْجَنَازَةَ حَتَّي يُصَلَّي عَلَيْهَا فَلَهُ قِيْرَاطٌ، وَمَنْ شَهِدَهَا حَتَّي تُدْفَنَ فَلَهُ قِيْرَاطَانِ، قِيْلَ: وَمَاالْقِيْرَاطَانِ؟ قَالَ: مِثْلُ الْجَبَلَيْنِ الْعَظِيْمَيْنِِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل الصلوة علي الجنازة واتباعها رقم:٢١٨٩ وفي رواية له: اَصْغَرُهُمَا مِثْلُ اُحُدٍ. رقم:٢١٩٢
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever stays with the janazah until the janazah Salah is finished will get one “qirat” of reward. Whoever stays with the janazah until it is buried will get two “qirats” of reward,” Rasulullah ﷺ was asked, “What are two qirats?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “Two qirats are equal to two huge mountains.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this. In another narration it has come: “The smaller of the two mountains will be like Mount Uhud.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا مِنْ مَيِّتٍ يُصَلِّيْ عَلَيْهِ اُمَّةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ يَبْلُغُوْنَ مِائَةً، كُلُّهُمْ يَشْفَعُوْنَ لَهُ اِلَّا شُفِّعُوْا فِيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب من صلي عليه مائة ... رقم:٢١٩٨
blocks.tamil_translation: .”If a large group of Muslims numbering a hundred attends any janazah Salah and intercedes with Allah for the deceased person (for forgiveness and mercy), Allah Ta'ala will certainly accept it.” Hazrat Aishah (RA) has narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ عَزَّي مُصَاباً فَلَهُ
